# Device commands

90 commands, in dispatch-table order. A device reports the same table at run time
with the `commands` command (firmware v1.15.0+). See PROTOCOL.md for the request and
reply envelope.

Flags:

- **maintenance**: refused with `maintenance_required` outside maintenance mode.
- **heavy**: over UDP, acked at once and run in the next gap between scans.
- **quiet**: never flashes the command LED (any command can ask for that with `"quiet":true`).
- **internal**: sent by the Desktop/Hub itself; not offered to users.
- **status snapshot**: the reply is a status the Desktop merges into its device state.

| Command | Flags | Summary |
|---|---|---|
| `status` | heavy, status snapshot | Query device status. (same handler as `query`) |
| `query` | heavy, status snapshot | Alias of status. (same handler as `status`) |
| `sensor_sample` |  | Read the latest IMU, magnetometer and battery values (firmware v1.6.0+). |
| `memory_status` | status snapshot | Heap totals and fragmentation. |
| `task_list` |  | List the scheduler's task table with per-task timing and CPU share. |
| `app_list` |  | List installed on-device apps with state, time budget and measured cost. |
| `app_view` | quiet | What each app slot shows on the OLED, status LED and external strip. |
| `app_enable` |  | Enable an installed app slot. (same handler as `app_disable`) |
| `app_disable` |  | Disable an app slot without uninstalling its package. (same handler as `app_enable`) |
| `app_revive` |  | Clear a budget-overrun kill and restart the app. |
| `app_events` | quiet | Events emitted by apps since a sequence number, with a dropped count. |
| `app_load_flow` |  | Load a flow graph into slot 0; rejected at load time if it exceeds the budget. |
| `app_unload_flow` |  | Unload the flow graph in slot 0. |
| `app_list_packages` |  | Installed app packages and which slot each is bound to. |
| `app_install` | maintenance | Install an uploaded .nha package into the registry. |
| `app_uninstall` | maintenance | Remove a package from the registry and delete its file. |
| `app_activate` | maintenance | Bind an installed package to a flow slot. |
| `app_deactivate` | maintenance | Unbind a package from its slot, leaving it installed. |
| `app_verify` |  | Re-hash an installed package and compare it with the index. |
| `app_reindex` | maintenance | Rebuild the package index from the .nha files present. |
| `config_schema` |  | Describe every configuration knob: path, type, range, and owning command. |
| `config_get` |  | Read one configuration path, or all of them when no path is given. |
| `config_set` |  | Write one configuration path; dispatches to the owning set_* handler. |
| `capabilities` |  | Report protocol, config schema hash, board features, and available subsystems. |
| `commands` | heavy | Every command this firmware accepts, with its flags (this table). |
| `set_power_profile` |  | Choose the idle CPU frequency policy (never applied while scanning). |
| `set_time` |  | Set a device's clock to the given time (--force overrides an active NTP/Hub source). |
| `clock_sync` |  | Re-sync the device clock now from its own source (the Gateway, else NTP, in WiFi mode; the Hub in ESP-NOW mode). |
| `clock_status` |  | Show the device clock: source, sync age, uncertainty and its clock settings. |
| `set_clock_config` |  | Set the NTP server and the NTP / Gateway sync intervals. |
| `service_list` |  | List supervised services with state, restart count, and health failures. |
| `service_restart` |  | Restart one supervised service without rebooting the device. |
| `scan_health` | status snapshot | Query lightweight scan, stream, memory, and control health. |
| `storage_status` | heavy, status snapshot | Flash filesystem usage per category (walks SPIFFS; slow). |
| `enter_maintenance` |  | Enter maintenance mode and stop normal scanning. |
| `exit_maintenance` | maintenance | Exit maintenance mode. |
| `set_scan_timing` |  | Configure matrix scan timing. WebUI offers 60/90 FPS presets; terminal can set custom values. |
| `set_transport` | internal | Switch the stream transport between WiFi/UDP and ESP-NOW (Hub). |
| `set_stream_buffer` |  | Enable or disable the packet ring buffer and choose standard or extended depth. |
| `set_matrix_layout` |  | Configure active analog and select pins. |
| `set_wifi` | internal | Store WiFi credentials and reconnect. |
| `findme_discover` |  | Run FindMe and attach to a New Horizons Gateway on the local network. |
| `findme_switch_gateway` |  | Ask the device to rerun FindMe with a preferred gateway claim. |
| `set_charge_profile` |  | Configure the charging profile. Profiles: ultra_slow (100mA), slow (200mA), balanced (250mA), fast (300mA), extreme (350mA). |
| `power_set_state` |  | Switch the device between normal mode and soft-off power states. Some boards use a remote-only soft-off UX. |
| `set_action_button` |  | Assign the action button's short and long press actions. |
| `set_filter` |  | Configure the per-cell median and low-pass filter. |
| `set_raw_adc` |  | Include the raw ADC block in streamed frames. |
| `set_battery_profile` |  | Set the manual battery profile (capacity, max charge current). |
| `battery_status` |  | The battery card's slice of status: charger, gauge and power state. |
| `resync_battery_gauge` |  | Restart the fuel gauge's state-of-charge estimate. |
| `set_imu` |  | Enable or disable the optional IMU service. |
| `set_log` |  | Configure device rolling log level and capacity. |
| `set_indicators` |  | Configure supported indicator hardware. Brightness expects decimal values such as 0.10, 0.35, 0.50, or 1.00. |
| `calibration_status` |  | Query manual calibration status, coverage, and metadata. |
| `calibration_enable` |  | Enable the saved manual calibration profile. |
| `calibration_disable` |  | Disable the saved manual calibration profile. |
| `calibration_session_begin` | maintenance | Start a draft calibration session. |
| `calibration_session_abort` | maintenance | Abort the current draft calibration session. |
| `calibration_session_commit` | maintenance | Commit the current draft calibration session. |
| `calibration_clear_profile` | maintenance | Delete the saved calibration profile and all stored levels. |
| `calibration_dump_tare` |  | Dump the saved and draft tare baseline matrix cells. |
| `calibration_dump_level` |  | Dump one calibration level with saved and draft matrix cells. |
| `calibration_dump_fit` |  | Dump every sensor's fitted coefficients (p = a + b*sqrt(x) + c*x) and fit result. |
| `calibration_set_fit` | maintenance | Set the fit inputs: lowest level used, each ADC's readout curve (dV = c1*x + c2*x^2) and clip level. |
| `calibration_set_reference` | maintenance | Set the pressure actually applied for one captured level (what the fit uses). |
| `calibration_delete_level` | maintenance | Delete one calibration level from the saved profile or current draft session. |
| `calibration_capture_tare` | maintenance | Capture the no-load tare baseline into the current draft calibration session. |
| `calibration_tare_capture` |  | Capture a tare in normal mode (pauses the scan briefly). |
| `calibration_tare_clear` |  | Clear the captured tare. |
| `calibration_capture_cell` | maintenance | Capture one sensor into the current draft calibration session. |
| `calibration_capture_all` | maintenance | Capture all active sensors into the current draft calibration session. |
| `file_list` |  | List maintenance files. Use --scope proc for live kernel state. |
| `file_read_begin` |  | Begin a maintenance-mode file read. |
| `file_read_chunk` |  | Read a maintenance-mode file chunk. The proc scope is readable outside maintenance. |
| `file_write_begin` | maintenance | Begin a maintenance-mode file write. |
| `file_write_chunk` | maintenance | Write a maintenance-mode file chunk. |
| `file_write_finish` | maintenance | Finish a maintenance-mode file write. |
| `file_delete` | maintenance | Delete a maintenance file. |
| `log_tail` |  | Read the last N log lines. |
| `dmesg` |  | Tail the in-RAM kernel log ring (no flash reads). |
| `log_clear` |  | Clear device.log and device.log.1. |
| `crash_log` |  | Show recorded panics/watchdog resets, with the faulting task and PC. |
| `health` |  | Show device health: power-on hours, reset counts, OTA history, temperature. |
| `crash_clear` |  | Erase the recorded crash ring and the stored core dump. |
| `set_ota_config` |  | Configure firmware updates: boot-time auto update, update channel (stable / beta), optional custom manifest URL. |
| `check_update` |  | Check the Arduino firmware update manifest. |
| `apply_update` |  | Apply an Arduino whole-firmware OTA update. |
| `reboot` |  | Reboot the current system. |
| `reboot_wifi_setup` |  | Reboot into the Wi-Fi setup portal, as holding the action button at power-on does. |
